dedupe_keys.name: anagrafe dell edilizia scolastica italian school buildings registry open data

description: The Italian education ministry publishes open data from the national school buildings registry, the Anagrafe dell'edilizia scolastica set up under law 23 of 1996, listing active state school buildings and their characteristics as reported by the provinces and municipalities that own them. Separate tables per school year cover building identity and location, surrounding environment, transport connections, legal constraints, size, functional spaces, removal of architectural barriers, age and origin of construction, structural units, safety certifications, heating type, energy-saving measures and noise protection, all linked by a building code. Coverage: Italy's state school buildings for school years 2020/21 to 2024/25, with an older series for 2017/18 and 2018/19. Access: CSV, JSON, RDF and XML downloads per year and a SPARQL endpoint, free; the latest files date from 6 August 2025. Licence: the licence field was blank on the pages read. Caveats: values are declared by the owning authorities, not surveyed by the ministry, and certification fields record documents held, not measured structural condition. Simulation uses are school building inventories with age, structure and certification status for earthquake and flood exposure, shelter planning and investment prioritisation. Related records: the French and German school master data, and the Italian observed damage database.
